name: Nether Earth ZS Edition '98: robotmenu
summary: The robot menu and its submenus: orders, distance, targets, combat, direct control.

entries.name: RobotMenu
entries.summary: landing on a robot of ours: DIRECT CONTROL, GIVE ORDERS, COMBAT MODE, LEAVE ROBOT; the order to +$0B

entries.name: RobotMenuShow
entries.summary: Robot menu: draw the four items, the current order and the strength, then choose

entries.name: ShowOrder
entries.summary: Robot menu: print the name of the robot's order

entries.name: ShowOrderMiles
entries.summary: Robot menu: for ADVANCE and RETREAT, the miles under the order's name

entries.name: ShowMilesCode
entries.summary: Code neither NE's recordings nor this part's ran: LD A,(IX+$0E); SRL A; CALL $D3E5

entries.name: RobotMenuChoose
entries.summary: Robot menu: choose an item and run it; LEAVE ROBOT closes the menu

entries.name: ShowStrength
entries.summary: Robot menus: print STRENGTH and the robot's strength in %

entries.name: ShowStrengthValue
entries.summary: Print the strength +$0C as "nnn%"

entries.name: DirectControlItem
entries.summary: Robot menu item 1: direct control, then the robot menu again

entries.name: DirectControl
entries.summary: Drive the robot with the controls until fire

entries.name: OrdersMenu
entries.summary: GIVE ORDERS: the five orders

entries.name: OrdersMenuChoose
entries.summary: GIVE ORDERS: choose; stop at once, advance / retreat ask the miles, search asks the target

entries.name: AdvanceJump
entries.summary: Code neither NE's recordings nor this part's ran: JR $AA40, past the RETREAT title

entries.name: RetreatTitle
entries.summary: GIVE ORDERS, RETREAT: the title of the distance menu

entries.name: DistanceMenu
entries.summary: Code neither NE's recordings nor this part's ran: CALL PrintInline, the distance menu's texts

entries.name: DistanceSelect
entries.summary: Code neither NE's recordings nor this part's ran: choose the miles, 0-50 by 5

entries.name: DistanceShow
entries.summary: the miles in D printed (PrintNumber2), a click, back to the distance loop

entries.name: TargetMenu
entries.summary: SEARCH & DESTROY or SEARCH & CAPTURE: the three targets

entries.name: DestroyMenuChoose
entries.summary: SEARCH & DESTROY: choose the target, orders 3-5

entries.name: CaptureMenu
entries.summary: SEARCH & CAPTURE: the three targets

entries.name: CaptureMenuChoose
entries.summary: SEARCH & CAPTURE: choose the target, orders 6-8

entries.name: SetOrder
entries.summary: Store a search order, look for its first target, or fall back to stop

entries.name: CombatMenuCode
entries.summary: Code neither NE's recordings nor this part's ran: the combat menu

entries.name: ListMenu
entries.summary: a list menu: HL the attribute of item 0 (an item every 3 rows), E the items + 1, A the first highlighted; down / up move, fire returns A

entries.name: PaintMenuItem
entries.summary: Colour list item A: 2 rows of 8 attributes with C

entries.name: WaitRelease
entries.summary: wait until no control is held

labels.comment: +$0A = 1: the player sits on it; the robot stops (UpdateRobot skips it)
the robot menu uses only the low byte of MenuCursor
$FD39 = 1: the panel shows the menu, UpdateStatusPanel keeps off it

labels.name: RobotMenuText
labels.comment: The robot menu: DIRECT CONTROL, GIVE ORDERS, COMBAT MODE, LEAVE ROBOT, -ORDERS-
AT (4,23), attribute $4D (cyan on blue, the list menu's normal colour): the four items
-ORDERS- at (17,23) in $46 (yellow): the heading over the current order
one more: the loop below adds 27 before the first name
order + 1 times: HL = OrderNames + 27 x order
into the string after the next CALL
the 27 bytes of the name, its end byte 0 included

labels.name: OrderLineHead
labels.comment: The order line: (18,23), attribute $45, then the copied name
AT (18,23), attribute $45 (cyan): then ShowOrder prints OrderLine

labels.name: OrderLine
labels.comment: The order's name, 27 bytes copied from OrderNames (DESTROY / ENEMY / ROBOTS in the file)
the order's three 9-character lines and the end 0, copied from OrderNames by ShowOrder
AT (19,25): the miles of ADVANCE / RETREAT, printed into the order's blank middle line
two digits, a leading space; then falls into RobotMenuChoose
remembered: the menu reopens on it
drive the robot, then this menu again
+$06 = 0: no steps left on its course, so it picks a new one
+$0A = 0: no longer held by the player
ClimbTurns = 5: the ship lifts off before the menu could reopen

labels.name: CloseRobotMenu
labels.comment: clear the panel and give it back to the status display
PanelBusy = 0: the status panel may print again
back to PlayLoop, after its CALL Z,RobotMenu
"STRENGTH", then the position of the value
then AT (23,25) in $47 (white): where ShowStrength prints the value

labels.name: ShowStrengthNumber
labels.comment: A = the strength (0 for a dying robot): three digits, leading spaces, then "%"

labels.name: OrderNames
labels.comment: The names of the orders, 27 bytes each (order 0: STOP AND DEFEND)

labels.name: OrderName1
labels.comment: Order 1: ADVANCE (the miles are printed into the blank middle line)

labels.name: OrderName2
labels.comment: Order 2: RETREAT (the miles in the middle line)
until fire (or the robot is destroyed)
the fire that chose the item must go first

labels.name: DirectControlLoop
labels.comment: a game turn with the robot driven
the clock and the turn pacing
Z: the robot is gone, return at once
back to the menu that called it
SELECT ORDERS and the five items

labels.name: OrdersMenuText
labels.comment: GIVE ORDERS: SELECT ORDERS and the five items
the heading SELECT / ORDERS at (4,24) in $47 (white)
the items in $4D (cyan on blue) from (7,23), two rows each
the attribute of item 0: row 4, column 23 (item 1 at row 7)
back to the robot menu, which shows the new order
3, 4 (SEARCH & DESTROY, & CAPTURE): the target menu, Z for destroy
clear the panel for the distance menu
ADVANCE: its title, then the distance menu
"ADVANCE " at (5,23) in $4F (white on blue): the distance menu's title
past the RETREAT title to the shared distance menu
the RETREAT title, then into DistanceMenu
"RETREAT " at (5,23) in $4F: the distance menu's title

labels.name: DistanceText
labels.comment: The distance menu: ?? MILES, SELECT DISTANCE, 0 MILES
"?? MILES" on the next row (6,23), under ADVANCE / RETREAT
"0 MILES" at (13,24) in $46 (yellow): the first value, then DistanceAtText reprints it

labels.name: DistanceLoop
labels.comment: a game turn under the open menu, then WaitKey: fire sets, down / up step the miles
the robots and the shots go on
the clock and the turn pacing
past 50 or below 0 (wrapped to $FB): keep the old value

labels.name: DistanceAtText
labels.comment: PrintInline: (13,23), attribute $46, where the miles are printed
AT (13,23), attribute $46: where DistanceShow prints the miles as they change
held keys step again after one game turn

labels.name: DistanceFire
labels.comment: fire: +$0E = miles x 2; 0 miles turns the order back into 0 (stop)
x2: +$0E counts map columns, 2 a mile

labels.name: DistanceDone
labels.comment: the beep, WaitRelease, back to the robot menu
SEARCH & DESTROY and its three targets

labels.name: DestroyMenuText
labels.comment: SEARCH & DESTROY: SELECT TARGET, ENEMY ROBOTS, FACTORYS, WARBASES
the title SEARCH & / DESTROY at (4,23)-(5,23) in $4F (white on blue)
the items in $4D from (12,23), two rows each
the attribute of item 0: row 9, column 23 (item 1 at row 12)
SEARCH & CAPTURE and its three targets

labels.name: CaptureMenuText
labels.comment: SEARCH & CAPTURE: SELECT TARGET, NEUTRAL FACTORYS, ENEMY FACTORYS, ENEMY WARBASES
the title SEARCH & / CAPTURE at (4,23)-(5,23) in $4F (white on blue)
the items in $4D from (12,23), two rows each
the attribute of item 0: row 9, column 23
no bomb: buildings cannot be destroyed
$FD51 = 0: the search runs for our side
A = the order for the search
back to the robot menu, which shows the order

labels.name: CombatMenu
labels.comment: COMBAT MODE: the six items, then the code at $AC7C
the six combat items, then the code at $AC7C

labels.name: CombatMenuText
labels.comment: COMBAT MODE: NUCLEAR BOMB, FIRE PHASERS, FIRE MISSILES, FIRE CANNON, MOVE ROBOT, STOP COMBAT
AT (4,23) in $4D (cyan on blue), two rows an item
item 1 NUCLEAR BOMB (part bit 6 of +$07), rows 4-5
item 6 STOP COMBAT (back to the robot menu), rows 19-20

labels.name: CombatMenuLoop
labels.comment: the combat list menu, A the highlighted item; 6 EXIT, 5 direct control, else a weapon
A = 5: the menu reopens on MOVE ROBOT

labels.name: CombatWeapon
labels.comment: a weapon item: shift its part bit of +$07 into carry

labels.name: CombatPartBit
labels.comment: rotate +$07 item + 1 times: carry = the robot has the weapon
item 1 bit 6 nuclear, 2 bit 5 phasers, 3 bit 4 missiles, 4 bit 3 cannon
IY = the robot: the blast's centre
a base in reach, every robot in 9 x 9 cells and this robot destroyed
the robot is gone with it: close the menu

labels.name: CombatFireShot
labels.comment: cannon / missiles / phasers: fire only when shot record 0 is free, then a turn
shot record 0 (Shots), the only one COMBAT MODE uses
still in the air: the buzz
the weapon number of the shot
launch it from IX along its facing +$08
the menu again on the same weapon

labels.name: CombatRefused
labels.comment: no such weapon or the shot still flies: the refusal beep, back to the menu
the menu again on that item
the fire or move that opened the menu must go first
drop our return: close the robot menu
the whole robot menu closed, back to PlayLoop
HL = the attribute of item 0 again
Input: bit 2 down, bit 3 up, bit 4 fire
bit 2 down / bit 3 up, now bits 1 / 2
neither: one game turn and read again
$4D: the old item back to normal

labels.name: ListMenuTurn
labels.comment: a game turn while the menu waits
the robots and the shots go on
the clock and the turn pacing (at least 10 frames a pass)
D = the item, E = the items + 1
check the robot, the next key
B = the item: the row loop count

labels.name: PaintMenuItemRow
labels.comment: HL += 3 attribute rows, A times: item A's top row
HL += $18: 8 cells already passed, so the next row's same column
